machine.load_note: run niced through slot.sh beside other builds: times are a loaded machine's

notes: played by hand buckets: every bucket holds the mix, so every hand does

flop, a combo on the turn (buckets).message: line ('bet 75%', 'raise to 12', 'call', '*'): this node is played by hand buckets, a combo has no strategy of its own there: lock the whole range, or solve the spot without buckets

notes: the river classes below assume ranges symmetric in the swapped suits, which a hand-scoped lock can break: the class subtrees then average the images' reaches

turn, a combo on the river (classes).message: line ('bet 125%', 'raise to 77.5', 'call', '*'): a river class's combo stands for its images on the class's other cards, so it can't name one hand: lock the whole range, or solve with river_classes off
